name: Calcharo

tierList.prydwen: T4 Tower of Adversity, T4 Whimpering Wastes

kit.intro: 5-star Electro Broadblade standard-banner Main DPS. Reputed as the hardest-to-optimize character in the game: gameplay revolves around building 'Killing Intent' (5 stacks via Basic 'Hounds Roar' during Ultimate state) to unleash repeated 'Death Messenger' Heavy Attacks that carry the bulk of his damage but have long, easily-interrupted wind-ups.

skills.normalAttack: Gnawing Fangs - up to 4 hits; replaced by 5-hit 'Hounds Roar' during Deathblade Gear.
skills.resonanceSkill: Extermination Order - up to 3 chained attacks, generates 'Cruelty' stacks.
skills.forte: Hunting Mission - at 3 Cruelty, Heavy Attack becomes 'Mercy' (Resonance/Concerto Energy recovery); at 5 Killing Intent (only gained in Deathblade Gear), Basic Attack becomes 'Death Messenger' Heavy Attack (core burst damage).
skills.liberation: Phantom Etching - Electro DMG, enters Deathblade Gear (Basic replaced by Hounds Roar; next Intro replaced by enhanced 'Necessary Means').
skills.intro: Wanted Outlaw - Electro DMG, notably long wind-up animation that costs time in ToA.
skills.outro: Shadowy Raid - summons a Phantom dealing ~196-392% ATK Electro DMG.

teams.name: Best Team
teams.notes: Yinlin is his only realistic viable Outro buffer (25% Liberation, 20% Electro DMG); Lynae is his best generalist buffer for Hypercarry.

rotation: Warm-up (Skill x3 stages + Heavy: Mercy) -> Intro -> Ultimate -> Death Messenger x2-4 interleaved with Hounds Roar basics (dash-cancelled for speed) -> Outro. A theoretical '4 Death Messenger' combo exists via perfect dash-cancels but is rated near-impossible difficulty; realistic play nets 2-3.
communityNotes: Prydwen: the most inconsistent, hardest-to-optimize DPS in the game — huge damage swings between 'perfect' and 'interrupted' rotations, near-zero AoE, and viable with essentially only one teammate (the limited 5-star Yinlin). Even at perfect play doesn't clearly surpass characters like Encore; not recommended except for players who love the character and want to master its execution ceiling.
